models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Light NE-to-N pattern over the islands now, seas under 2.5 ft - but trip dates are still outside every model's reach.
briefing.synopsis: ECMWF IFS, AIFS and ICON-2i (all 26 Sep 00Z) agree on a light northeasterly-to-northerly flow across the archipelago, 6-10 kt at the outer islands and under 6 kt in the Portorosa approaches, with seas 1-2 ft. Through 27 Sep the flow backs slowly from NE toward N and eases; by 28 Sep all three runs collapse the gradient to 1-3 kt with wave and swell of 0.4-0.7 ft, i.e. near-calm and motoring air. Model spread is small where it matters - the only flagged disagreements are Filicudi 26 Sep 06:00 (5.8-12.1 kt) and Portorosa 28 Sep (0.5-7.0 kt), both in light air. Critically, the forecast horizon here ends 2 Oct 23:00; departure is 3-4 Oct, so nothing in this payload speaks to the trip itself.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Tonight, 26 Sep, the boats sit at Portorosa Marina - enclosed, all-round shelter, and the only option scored here, so the choice does not matter. IFS 00Z has Portorosa at 5.1 kt from the N at 18:00, gusting 12.4, with 1.2 ft of wave and 1.0 ft of swell, building to 1.5 ft wave overnight. Nothing in that would move the fleet.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: 27 Sep stays light: Portorosa 3.4 kt from the NNE at 06:00 rising to 5.7 kt NNW by midday (IFS/AIFS/ICON-2i, 26 Sep 00Z), with the outer islands 6-10 kt NE and waves 1.4-2.2 ft, largest at Panarea and Stromboli around 06:00. Any hour of the morning is a workable departure window on these numbers; expect to motorsail rather than carry a breeze. Again, this is the rehearsal picture, not your 4 Oct start.

passage_notes.note: 'Go' at 1.9 kt, head to wind - motoring passage in the rehearsal picture.

passage_notes.note: 'Go' at 3.4 kt on a run; gusts to 10 kt on a 3 kt mean are single-model interval maxima.

cautions: Every figure above is a rehearsal against live weather for 26 Sep - 2 Oct. The forecast horizon ends 2 Oct 23:00 and departure is 3-4 Oct; no model in this payload covers a single trip date.

Forecast stability at 72-120 h lead shows mean wind shifts of only 1.0 kt but mean direction shifts of 62° - at a week out, direction is effectively unresolved, and direction is what decides berth exposure at Panarea and Stromboli.
Marina del Gabbiano at Stromboli scores only 'workable' even in the rehearsal: open from every direction, shelter there depends entirely on it staying calm. That berth needs a fresh look 48 h out.
Gust figures from ECMWF IFS are interval maxima, so ratios like 22.2 kt gust against 8.9 kt mean at Filicudi (26 Sep 06:00) overstate what you will feel on deck.
briefing.confidence_note: IFS, AIFS and ICON-2i (all 26 Sep 00Z) agree closely on the next 48 h - mean wind shift under 1 kt out to 72 h across 23 compared snapshots - but nothing is available for the trip dates themselves, so confidence in the current pattern is good and confidence in the trip is nil.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
